common.siteTagline: YOU ARE FRAGILE. LEARN OR DIE.

home.heroTagline: You are sent to recover pages from a lethal maze. You are fragile. If you want to come back alive, you must learn faster than the place kills you.
home.chapter1P1: Your mind has been stripped. Memories remain only as fragments — scattered images, half-words, the ghost of a face you can no longer name.
home.chapter1P2: You are not in a body. Not in a place. You are awareness suspended in an absence that presses against you like weight.
home.chapter2P1: Humanity tried to materialize psychic energy. To give thought a form, to give consciousness a body. The experiment was not a failure — it was a catastrophe.
home.chapter2P2: What they called the Cataclysm was not an explosion. It was a silence that swallowed cities from within. The energy they sought to harness was never inert.
home.chapter3Title: The tower at the center is not architecture
home.chapter3P1: It is a library woven from psychic energy. Every thought ever thought within its radius becomes a volume. Every fear, a corridor. Every memory, a locked door.
home.chapter3P2: The Pages you are sent to recover are not paper. They are crystallized cognition — someone's experience, someone's death, someone's secret, pressed into a form that can be carried.
home.chapter4Title: Do not see. Do not hear. Do not speak.
home.chapter4P1: Three laws. Three monsters. Each one is a response to a specific category of human action. The system does not punish intent. It punishes the signals you cannot stop yourself from sending.
home.chapter4P2: The first hunts what it can see. The second hunts what it can hear. The third hunts what you give voice to — even inside your own mind. These are not metaphors.
home.chapter5Title: Are you the words in the book, or the hand turning the page?
home.chapter5P1: By now you have gathered fragments. You have survived. You have learned. But every answer the Maze gives you is also a question about yourself.
home.chapter5P2: The Pages you carry are not just data. They are pieces of someone. And every time you extract one, you leave something of yourself behind in the Maze. The question is not whether you will escape. It is whether you will still be you when you do.

about.title: THE GAME
about.subtitle: Mission-driven horror expedition
about.worldviewP1: Humanity is being manipulated by a higher-dimensional or cybernetic controlling force. Human workers are not honored explorers; they are managed, replaceable labor bodies.
about.worldviewP2: You are a worker. Your job is to enter the Maze, recover Pages, and return. What the Pages truly are — and why the controlling authority values them so highly — is not something you are meant to understand.
about.coreRuleDesc: Every action you take in the Maze generates noise. Noise feeds the predator's tracking model. The louder and more continuous your noise profile, the faster and more aggressively it hunts you. Walking is safe. Running starts to give you away. Opening doors, using tools, breaking objects — every time you choose efficiency, you also choose to let the predator get closer.
about.soundTierIntro: Drag the slider or click a tier to see how noise changes your situation. Each tier corresponds to a different detection distance and chase speed for the predator.
about.soundTierLowDesc: Walking, minor movement, short small actions. Minimal risk. The predator can only detect you at very close range.
about.soundTierMidDesc: Running, standard map interactions, light tool usage. Begins tracking. The predator locks onto a general direction and moves toward the sound source.
about.soundTierHighDesc: Heavy doors, forced interactions, impacts, loud tool noise. Accelerated pursuit. The predator closes in at full speed — pressure escalates rapidly.
about.soundTierSpecialDesc: Voice activity through microphone. Proximity, volume, and decay model apply. Full danger state. Execution mode.
about.soundTierDistance: At this tier, the predator can hear you from ~{distance} studs away
about.headlineBehaviorDesc: The predator enters a tracking state when triggered by noise events. Sustained noise amplifies pursuit pressure. Silence and stillness degrade its tracking lock. It does not know everything — but it knows what you give it. Understanding its state transitions is the foundation of all survival knowledge.
about.headlinePerceptionDesc: This threat does not rely on vision. It navigates and hunts exclusively through sound events. It does not need to see you to begin its approach. It hears you. The diagram below shows how sound propagates through the Maze — and how dangerous your noise is at various distances.
about.headlineChase3: 3. Player realizes they are helping the hunt succeed
about.headlineChase4: 4. Player chooses: continue panic, or exercise restraint
about.headlineChase5: 5. Outcome becomes a readable cause-and-effect chain
about.headlineFairness1: Before first high-pressure contact, the player encounters at least one warning read
about.headlineFairness2: Death cannot come primarily from completely unreadable instant locks
about.headlineFairness3: During a chase, there must always exist room for "doing better to survive longer"
about.headlineFairness4: After death, the player should be able to identify what to do less of next time
about.clueText: "...the previous crew — what was left of them — we found the recorder. You can hear it in the background. Not footsteps. Just... approach. They were too loud. They didn't know. They ran, and it found them every time."
about.stateIdleDesc: The predator roams the Maze without actively searching for a target.
about.stateIdleTrigger: Entry: No noise events, or previous tracking target has been lost.
about.stateTrackingDesc: The predator has locked onto a general direction and is moving toward the sound source.
about.stateTrackingTrigger: Entry: Noise tier ≥ 2, or sustained low-tier noise accumulation.
about.stateTrackingExit: Exit: Arrives at sound source without finding target → Investigating; prolonged silence → Idle.
about.stateInvestigatingDesc: The predator has reached the last known sound source and is searching the immediate area.
about.stateInvestigatingTrigger: Entry: Arrived at sound source location without confirming target.
about.stateInvestigatingExit: Exit: Target found → Hunting; no new stimulus → Idle.
about.stateHuntingDesc: The predator has confirmed target location and is in full pursuit.
about.stateHuntingTrigger: Entry: Player position confirmed during Tracking or Investigating.
about.stateHuntingExit: Exit: Player evades perception range for long enough.
about.stateLethalDesc: The predator enters execution mode. Escape is impossible.
about.stateLethalTrigger: Entry: Distance ≤ melee range during Hunting, or special sound tier triggered.
about.runDesc: The camp and wilderness layer. Prepare, regroup, and gather clues. Optional discoveries in the wilderness can change how you interpret danger before entering the Maze.
about.mazeDesc: The lethal execution layer. Face high-threat chase rules that punish panic and ignorance. Grab Pages under pressure and decide whether to push deeper or retreat.
about.returnDesc: Bring Pages back to camp. Death costs something real — you lose what you carried. Successful return feels like progress, but the loop continues.
about.pagesP1: Pages are the surface economy of Liminal. They are your mission objective, your camp currency, and your reason to risk going deeper. Use Pages to acquire better tools for the next round.
about.pagesP2: But ask yourself: why does the authority value these Pages so highly? What is really being harvested?
about.retreatP1: Not every round should drain you completely. Bringing back the Pages you already have is itself a high-quality decision. The tension between "get more" and "get out now" should always be real.
about.retreatP2: Survivors attempt to bring resources back before the round expires. Across rounds, you gradually understand the rules that govern survival. This understanding is your true progression.
about.toolsP1: Tools improve spatial readability and execution stability. They give you more restrained, more confident ways to act.
about.toolsP2: Tools should NOT: erase threat rules, make knowledge obsolete, or let you believe "better gear" is the core growth path.
about.aftermathP1: When you die, you lose what you carried. But you should never lose what you learned. If you can say "next time I will sprint less" or "next time I will listen before opening that door," the death was not wasted.
about.aftermathP2: The question after every failed extraction: what did you do that helped it find you?
about.round1: ROUND 1 — Establish mission, route, threat suspicion
about.round2: ROUNDS 2-3 — The impulse to bet higher with growing understanding
about.round3: ROUND 4 — Pressure escalates; greed and preservation tear at each other
about.round4: ROUND 5 — Closing pressure should feel distinct, not just another run
about.philosophyP1: Liminal is not about becoming stronger. It is about becoming less blind inside a system that treats human beings as expendable exploration bodies.
about.philosophyP2: The player's strongest real growth is cognitive, not stat-based. The final narrative realization should be that the player was only ever a tool.
